result.question: How does Uzziah follow his father's example?

readings.answer: By doing what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as Amaziah had done
readings.support: he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly says, “he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done,” directly answering how he followed his father’s example. The key’s added element (“sought God”) is not tied to the father in the text.
